title.narrative: Technical assistance on health systems management and health care labor market

description.narrative: The project provides specialised technical assistance on health systems management, resilience and health care labor markets that is required for the execution of project PST26UA01 (Impact of EU integration on healthcare workforce migration in Ukraine). It delivers strategic supervision, methodological guidance, and comparative European Union (EU) expertise to guarantee analytical quality, cross-country comparability, and policy credibility of the outcomes of project PST26UA01. The project supports the Ministry of Economy of Ukraine to define public policies mitigating negative impacts; and preventing massive healthcare workforce migration as consequence of the adoption of the EU framework of directives, as part of the process of integration of Ukraine to the European Union. This enables Ukraine to ensure stability of the health system and a long-term resilient provision of health services by public and private providers. The project has a positive impact on:SDG 8: inclusive and sustainable economic growth: support productive activities, decent job creation, entrepreneurship, creativity and innovation, access to markets, etc.SDG 3: Good health and wellbeing.
